name: 2 Kings
title: 2 Kings — Long Road to Exile
tagline: Patience exhausted; Assyria and Babylon come.
audience: People under judgment learning the justice of God.
purpose: Explain exile as covenant curse, not divine failure.
christ: The lamp for David’s sake (8:19) kept until the true Son.
spirit: God still speaks in collapse; the word does not fail.
jesus_in_this_book: The lamp for David’s sake (8:19) kept until the true Son.
how_to_read: Reform matters — but half-measures do not stop exile forever.
watchman_charge: Do not confuse a revival season with finished holiness.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
